## Review result

No candidate-caused blocking security or privacy defect was admitted. The sole R4 blocker is structurally repaired and is now exercised through concrete System Accessibility and real executor paths. The remaining security boundaries were re-traced in current production rather than inferred from static source-oracle tests or aggregate green counts.

## R4 blocker closure: live cancellation and deadline propagation

- `validateExactFocusReadback` now passes the attempt's live `cancellationProbe` into the focused-element `copyAttribute` call (`FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1240-1255`). A cancellation latched after the preceding messaging-timeout return is therefore observed before the next AX copy, closing the exact post-revocation read proven in R4.
- Every validation-critical low-level System AX helper now requires an explicit probe; none retains the former default `{ false }` argument. This includes timeout setup, attribute copy, PID readback, settable query, selected-range readback, focus restoration, selection restoration, and string readback (`FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1558-1619`, `FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1635-1824`, `FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1899-1937`). Each helper checkpoints cancellation and the immutable absolute deadline before the AX operation and after its synchronous return, before any next operation. Selected-range readback additionally checkpoints before extracting the AX value.
- The only explicit `{ false }` probes are confined to capture-time wrappers, before an attempt handle or confirmation authority exists (`FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:795-817`, `FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:949-1015`, `FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1621-1633`, `FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1826-1835`). They cannot be selected by validation or commit, so they do not recreate the R4 revocation bypass.
- The concrete late-readback test materializes a real `NSWindow` and `NSTextView`, uses `SystemReviewSubmissionAXRuntime`, latches cancellation at the post-restoration timeout, and proves the trace terminates there without the subsequent focused-element copy (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:540-623`). The companion test routes the same real runtime through `ReviewSubmissionExecutor`, enqueues exact-handle cancellation on the real control plane, and proves `.notStarted(.cancellation)`, no prepared pair, and no post operation (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:625-742`).
- The concrete System matrix records the reachable exact and application-bound runtime traces, then injects cancellation and deadline expiry at every recorded step occurrence. Every case must terminate with the matching failure and no later AX step (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:744-833`, `FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:3251-3485`). This covers the earlier downstream hole instead of testing only the first timeout edge.
- Independent R5 execution of those three selectors completed with 3 tests, 0 failures, and `TEST SUCCEEDED`: `test_v5SystemAXExactFocusReadbackCancellationAfterRestorationStopsBeforeCopy`, `test_v5SystemAXExactFocusReadbackCancellationStopsExecutorBeforePairOrPosts`, and `test_v5SystemAXCancellationAndDeadlineCoverEveryReachableExactAndApplicationBoundStep`. Result bundle: `/tmp/issue40-security-r5-dd/Logs/Test/Test-FeishuSpeech-2026.08.24_17-39-35-+0800.xcresult`.

## Immediate commit validation and target binding

- Pair construction and complete payload/provenance readback finish before `commit`; every epoch-reservation retry returns through `validateForImmediateCommit` without reconstructing or changing the pair (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:846-858`, `FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:946-1005`, `FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:1064-1076`).
- The concrete System validator performs a leading security composite, binding-specific validation, and a trailing security composite immediately before the modifier and epoch gates (`FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:845-898`). Each composite samples Secure Input, Accessibility trust, full application identity, and frontmost PID with cancellation and deadline checkpoints around every synchronous result (`FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1325-1385`). Modifier validation remains cancellation-bracketed and precedes the epoch reservation (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:742-752`, `FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:988-1001`).
- Application-bound ordinary capability miss is restricted to `noValue` or `attributeUnsupported` while reading focus from the captured application AX object. It remains provisional until the trailing security composite succeeds; PID mismatch, Secure Input, trust loss, identity/frontmost drift, timeout, cancellation, and unverifiable failures fail closed (`FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1017-1088`). Exact-cursor validation retains the captured element and range, verifies the captured PID, restores and reads back exact focus and selection, and never downgrades to application-bound delivery (`FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1091-1305`).
- The immutable target identity includes positive PID, bundle identifier, executable URL, and launch date. Both prepared events remain bound to that captured PID, and no ambient frontmost lookup can replace it after confirmation (`FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:837-898`, `FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:438-500`).

## Cancellation, lifecycle, physical input, and terminal semantics

- An admitted start that has expired is retired under the control-plane store lock, clears only its matching active handle, emits exactly one `.notStarted(.deadline)` terminal, and enqueues no raw work. Later cancellation or cleanup cannot find the retired record or emit a second terminal (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:176-264`). The concrete executor and coordinator tests prove no raw start, empty records, exact draft recovery, and that a new real Send is required for another attempt (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:696-734`, `FeishuSpeechTests/ReviewFirstMainViewModelTests.swift:527-605`).
- System lifecycle observation uses distinct opaque leases tied to stable captured application identity. Overlapping captures are independently retained; stale or mismatched release cannot retire a newer lease. Initial observer installation fails closed, and lifecycle or physical observations only advance the shared epoch rather than creating confirmation authority (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:1184-1326`, `FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:1493-1575`).
- The HID event tap advances the combined epoch before dispatch and always advances it for tap-disabled events (`FeishuSpeech/Services/HotKeyService.swift:202-224`, `FeishuSpeech/Services/CurrentFocusAppendSession.swift:204-218`). Synthetic exemptions in both event-tap and AppKit observation require the exact private tag and this process's PID (`FeishuSpeech/Services/TextInputSimulator.swift:597-606`, `FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:1318-1326`). Pending physical/lifecycle interference is visible before reservation under the fixed lock order (`FeishuSpeech/Services/CurrentFocusAppendSession.swift:261-372`).
- The first Unicode down post is the only irreversible boundary. If it occurs, the matching up is attempted synchronously exactly once immediately afterward regardless of advisory cancellation, close, or Escape. All post-boundary outcomes are `submittedUnverified`; no branch reports target consumption, returns to cancellable state, retries, or resends (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:1008-1048`).

## Payload, gesture provenance, and side-effect confinement

- Admission and pair construction cap the exact draft at 16,384 UTF-16 code units. The private-source down/up pair has empty flags, exact private tag, own source PID, and the exact `[UInt16]` payload, including surrogate pairs; all fields are read back before the pair can be committed (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:128-150`, `FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewSubmissionExecutor.swift:438-582`). Both posts use the same immutable captured target PID.
- `ReviewConfirmationIntent` is constructible only by the real review controller's Send-button and qualified panel-Return paths (`FeishuSpeech/Controllers/ReviewWindowController.swift:11-35`). Return requires the exact key panel/window, main Return or keypad Enter, no repeat or disallowed modifier, a responder inside the panel, nonblank text, and no marked-text composition (`FeishuSpeech/Controllers/ReviewWindowController.swift:38-91`, `FeishuSpeech/Controllers/ReviewWindowController.swift:669-705`). Production tests cover positive confirmation and the wrong-window, non-key, repeat, modifier, multiline, IME, whitespace, and immediate-edit negatives (`FeishuSpeechTests/TranscriptionReviewViewTests.swift:688-1032`). Coordinator tests drive real mouse or keyboard events and cannot mint the opaque intent directly (`FeishuSpeechTests/ReviewFirstMainViewModelTests.swift:2000-2089`).
- Before a real Send or qualified Return, streaming, sealing, preview, and every editing character only mutate the review state. The default MainViewModel uses `SystemReviewSubmissionFacade`, and admission begins only after opaque confirmation (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:343-400`, `FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:2120-2210`). The nonactivating review panel neither activates an application nor captures global Return, and it requires the captured application to remain frontmost for readiness (`FeishuSpeech/Controllers/ReviewWindowController.swift:157-207`, `FeishuSpeech/Controllers/ReviewWindowController.swift:275-310`, `FeishuSpeech/Controllers/ReviewWindowController.swift:551-579`).
- No accepted-path pasteboard read, write, snapshot, restore, copy, Cmd+V, app activation, retarget, pre-confirm AX mutation, keyboard post, retry, or delivery route was found. The former delayed image-paste mechanism is structurally absent: the only external text signal is the one prepared Unicode down/up pair after successful confirmation and all immediate gates.
- Reviewed logging contains status, phase, timing, predicates, and typed errors only; no draft, preview, frozen payload, or transcript content is formatted into a log. Pre-boundary uncertainty preserves the exact editable draft; post-boundary uncertainty dismisses ordinary confirmation authority without claiming consumption or exposing a resend surface (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:2315-2413`).

The candidate does not modify `AudioRecorder`, `FeishuStreamingSession`, `FeishuAPIService`, `HoldPacketJournal`, `ByteBoundedAudioIngress`, or `DirectFeishuKeepAliveSession`; the independent recording and recognition lines remain intact.
